title: Releasing a list or tree of records
summary: Proves that release frees an owned value of a recursive type, a tree of records with pairwise disjoint blocks, keeping every region of the old heap that lies apart from the tree.
premises: The module has no imports and release at function 1
The source local holds the value's pointer
Heap.At for the store, NodeOwned for the value, and its blocks pairwise disjoint, as Represent.owned gives for a call's result
result: The state is unchanged; some heap satisfies the allocator invariant; the pages and memory caps are unchanged; and every region of positive size of the old heap apart from the value's blocks keeps its bytes and stays a region.
